mapper.select: SELECT TERMS_NO AS terms_no, PRODUCT_NO AS product_no, TERMS_TITLE AS terms_title, TERMS_TYPE AS terms_type, PDF_URL AS pdf_url, TERMS_SUMMARY AS terms_summary, TERMS_VERSION AS terms_version, USE_YN AS use_yn FROM TB_PRODUCT_TERMS WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN TERMS_TITLE = '상품설명서' THEN 1 WHEN TERMS_TITLE = '예금거래기본약관' THEN 2 WHEN TERMS_TITLE = '적립식예금약관' THEN 3 WHEN TERMS_TITLE = '거치식예금약관' THEN 3 WHEN TERMS_TITLE = '상품특약' THEN 4 ELSE 99 END, TERMS_NO
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PRODUCT_TERMS WHERE PRODUCT_NO BETWEEN #{startProductNo} AND #{endProductNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRODUCT_TERMS ( PRODUCT_NO, TERMS_TITLE, TERMS_TYPE, PDF_URL, TERMS_SUMMARY, TERMS_VERSION, USE_YN, UPLOADED_AT ) VALUES ( #{product_no}, #{terms_title}, #{terms_type}, #{pdf_url}, #{terms_summary}, #{terms_version}, #{use_yn}, SYSDATE )
